stemEn: A child with Albright hereditary osteodystrophy features has pseudohypoparathyroidism. What laboratory pattern is expected?
explanationAr: Pseudohypoparathyroidism يعني PTH resistance؛ لذلك calcium منخفض وphosphate مرتفع مع PTH مرتفع غالبًا.
reasoningEn: End-organ resistance to PTH causes hypocalcemia and hyperphosphatemia despite elevated PTH.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: Differentiate pseudohypoparathyroidism from true hypoparathyroidism by the PTH level.

stemEn: A 9-month-old exclusively breastfed infant has a femoral fracture and radiographic rickets. Which laboratory finding is expected?
explanationAr: في nutritional rickets غالبًا يكون phosphate منخفضًا بسبب secondary hyperparathyroidism وزيادة renal phosphate loss. Calcium قد يكون طبيعيًا أو منخفضًا.
reasoningEn: Hypophosphatemia is common in active nutritional rickets due to secondary hyperparathyroidism and phosphaturia.
incorrectOptionsAr: Hyperphosphatemia ليست متوقعة؛ hypercalcemia ليست النمط؛ hypocalciuria قد تحدث لكنها أقل عمومية من hypophosphatemia.
clinicalPearl: Check calcium, phosphate, ALP, PTH and 25-OH vitamin D in suspected rickets.

stemEn: An 8-month-old exclusively breastfed infant has radiographic rickets. If hypophosphatemia is not offered, which urinary calcium pattern may be seen in calcipenic rickets?
explanationAr: في calcipenic rickets يحاول الجسم حفظ calcium، لذا urinary calcium قد يكون منخفضًا. لكن السؤال أضعف من Q26 ويحتاج ربطه بالـfull biochemical context.
reasoningEn: Secondary hyperparathyroidism in calcipenic rickets promotes renal calcium conservation, producing low urinary calcium.
incorrectOptionsAr: Hypercalciuria لا تناسب الحالة؛ hypophosphaturia تتعارض مع PTH-driven phosphaturia في nutritional rickets.
clinicalPearl: Biochemical patterns vary by rickets subtype; do not memorize one urine finding without context.

stemEn: A 16-month-old child has radiographic rickets. Which laboratory test is essential in the initial evaluation?
recalledAnswer: C in the source, but several tests are part of the initial workup
explanationAr: التقييم الأولي الصحيح لا يعتمد على اختبار واحد فقط؛ يشمل calcium, phosphate, ALP, PTH, creatinine وغالبًا 25-OH vitamin D. لذلك مفتاح واحد مثل calcium وحده قد يكون exam-dependent وليس قاعدة كاملة.
reasoningEn: Rickets evaluation requires a biochemical panel; selecting a single indispensable test from these options is oversimplified.
incorrectOptionsAr: 1,25-OH2 D ليس أفضل screening test لvitamin D stores؛ لكن 25-OH D وPTH أيضًا مهمان، لذلك السؤال يحتاج مراجعة صياغته الأصلية.
clinicalPearl: Classify rickets as calcipenic versus phosphopenic using the overall biochemical pattern.

stemEn: A child has inability to walk, tetany, hypocalcemia, elevated PTH and classic radiographic bone changes. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: في الطفل مع growth plates مفتوحة، defective mineralization يؤدي إلى rickets. Elevated PTH يستبعد hypoparathyroidism.
reasoningEn: Defective mineralization at growing physes in a child is rickets, not isolated osteomalacia.
incorrectOptionsAr: Osteoporosis نقص كتلة عظمية دون classic rachitic changes؛ hypoparathyroidism يكون PTH منخفضًا؛ osteomalacia مصطلح يصف mineralization defect في العظم الناضج أكثر.
clinicalPearl: Rickets and osteomalacia can coexist, but physeal changes define rickets in children.

stemEn: A boy has bow legs and his brother has similar findings. Which inherited rickets disorder is most likely?
explanationAr: Familial bowing/rickets يجعل inherited phosphate-wasting disorder مثل X-linked hypophosphatemia احتمالًا مهمًا، خصوصًا مع hypophosphatemia وrenal phosphate wasting.
reasoningEn: A familial pattern of rickets with phosphate wasting is compatible with X-linked hypophosphatemia.
incorrectOptionsAr: Nutritional vitamin D deficiency لا يعطي عادةً pattern عائلي واضح؛ hypophosphatasia لها low ALP وميزات مختلفة.
clinicalPearl: FGF23 excess drives renal phosphate wasting in XLH.

stemEn: A child with Crohn disease taking a proton pump inhibitor develops muscle weakness and a positive Chvostek sign. Hypocalcemia is not listed. Which electrolyte abnormality best explains the picture?
explanationAr: GI loss/malabsorption قد يسبب hypomagnesemia، وهي قد تؤدي إلى neuromuscular irritability وsecondary hypocalcemia بسبب impaired PTH secretion/resistance. PPI association عادة مع الاستخدام المزمن أكثر من شهرين، لذا السياق يحتاج انتباه.
reasoningEn: Hypomagnesemia can cause tetany and secondary hypocalcemia, especially with gastrointestinal losses or malabsorption.
incorrectOptionsAr: Hypokalemia تسبب weakness/arrhythmia أكثر من Chvostek؛ hyponatremia لا تعطي هذا النمط.
clinicalPearl: Check magnesium in otherwise unexplained or refractory hypocalcemia.

stemEn: After prolonged immobilization for a fracture, a child becomes irritable and constipated with hematuria and hypertension. Which test among the recalled choices can help assess hypercalciuria?
explanationAr: Immobilization قد يسبب hypercalcemia من increased bone resorption، وقد ينتج hypercalciuria, stones وhematuria. Urine Ca/Cr مفيد، لكن overall hypercalcemia workup يبدأ أيضًا بتأكيد serum calcium وPTH.
reasoningEn: A urine calcium/creatinine ratio helps quantify hypercalciuria in a child with suspected immobilization hypercalcemia.
incorrectOptionsAr: IVP ليس first-line؛ Doppler لا يقيس hypercalciuria؛ psychiatric referral غير مناسب.

stemEn: A wheelchair-dependent child after orthopedic surgery has hypercalcemia with an elevated PTH. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: Immobilization hypercalcemia يكون PTH منخفضًا/مكبوتًا. ارتفاع PTH مع hypercalcemia يشير إلى PTH-dependent hypercalcemia مثل primary hyperparathyroidism.
reasoningEn: An elevated PTH in hypercalcemia argues against immobilization and supports primary hyperparathyroidism.
incorrectOptionsAr: Immobility raises calcium through bone resorption and should suppress PTH.
clinicalPearl: Always classify hypercalcemia as PTH-dependent versus PTH-independent early in the workup.
